sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: One player takes the role of Michael Myers, stalking Haddonfield while four Civilian players try to survive. Single-player content is also confirmed.

sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: Four players take Civilian roles against Michael Myers. Official materials describe cooperation, scavenging, and escape. Richard and Alexis are confirmed Digital Deluxe Edition Civilians; this is not a complete character roster.
